title: Branded site
description: Brand and content on top of the ready theme: colors, texts, images and SEO. Changes stay in the draft until you preview and publish them.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view the branded site settings.
load_failed: The site settings could not be loaded.
conflict.title: Someone else changed the settings
conflict.description: Load the current settings before saving. Your unsaved changes will be lost.
conflict.toast: The settings changed meanwhile; the current state was loaded. Please try again.
save_bar.draft_hint: Saved content is a draft; visitors see it after you publish. On / off, address and language apply at once.
toast.restored: The revision was restored to the draft. Remember to publish it.
toast.shown_online: Now shown on the site and the widget.
toast.hidden_online: Hidden on the site and the widget.
validation.subdomain: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; it cannot start or end with a hyphen.
validation.phone: 7-20 digits; spaces, (), - and a leading + are allowed.
validation.ga4: A GA4 measurement ID looks like G-XXXXXXX.
general.live_description: These settings apply as soon as you save (no publish needed).
general.enabled_hint: While off the address shows nothing. Switching on also creates the site's booking key.
general.subdomain_hint: The site's address: {subdomain}.rentopia.app. The old address stops working when it changes.
general.never_published: Never published: visitors see nothing even while the site is on. Publish it from the Publishing tab.
general.blockers.key_missing: No booking key is linked to the site (created when the site is switched on).
general.blockers.key_inactive: The site key is revoked or expired: renew the key.
general.blockers.channel_off: The web sales channel is off in the organization settings.
general.renew_description: The site switches to a new publishable key. The old key keeps working for open visitor sessions for one more hour, then stops.
theme.colors_description: An empty color uses the default.
theme.dark_colors_description: Used when the mode is dark or follows the system.
theme.layout_description: Ready-made variants of the current site template; new themes use their own theme settings.

seo.title: Search engines (SEO)

seo.meta_description_hint: Shown in search results; at most {{max}} characters.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Google Analytics 4 loads only with a valid measurement ID, with IP anonymization.
images.title: Images
images.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP (SVG is not accepted). An uploaded image is a draft; it appears on the site after publishing.
images.hints.logo: In the header; at most {{size}} MB. Falls back to the organization logo.
images.hints.favicon: In the browser tab; square, at most {{size}} MB.
images.hints.cover: In the cover-image hero; at most {{size}} MB.
images.remove_description: It is removed from the draft; the live site keeps the old image until the next publish.
images.invalid_type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP can be uploaded.
images.too_large: The file can be at most {{size}} MB.
publish.up_to_date: The draft matches the live revision.
publish.nothing: There are no changes to publish.

publish.confirm_live: Visitors see the new revision at once. You can roll back to an earlier revision from the history.
publish.confirm_off: The revision is published; as the site is off, visitors see it once you switch it on.
publish.restore_description: The current draft is replaced with this revision. Publish afterwards to make it live.
publish.load_failed: The publish history could not be loaded.
publish.empty_description: After the first publish every publish is listed here as a revision.
catalog.description: Which branches, vehicle subgroups and extras the branded site and the widget offer. Changes apply at once.
catalog.extras_hint: The extra's sales channels do not change; this only sets whether the site and the widget show it.
catalog.load_failed: The catalog could not be loaded.
widget.domains_description: Sites that may embed the widget (https://domain.com); at most {{max}}.
widget.filters_description: Values preselected in the search form when the widget opens.
preview.title: Site preview
preview.description: The saved draft on the site's own address. Bookings are disabled in a preview.
preview.unsaved: Unsaved changes do not appear in the preview; save the draft first.
preview.failed: The preview link could not be created.
catalog.show_online_hint: When off it is hidden on the branded site and the widget; API integrations are not affected.
domains.title: Custom domains
domains.description: Besides its subdomain, your site can open on your own domain. Add the domain and create the DNS records shown at your DNS provider; once verified it goes live with HTTPS.
domains.add_hint: Enter the host only (e.g. booking.yourcompany.com). Up to 3 domains per organization.
domains.records_hint: Create these records in your DNS provider's panel. Changes can take a few minutes to a few hours to spread; verification is retried automatically.
domains.remove_description: The site stops opening on this domain and its booking origin is removed. You can delete the DNS records afterwards.
domains.errors.DOMAIN_LIMIT: At most 3 domains can be added.
domains.errors.DOMAIN_TAKEN: This domain is used by another organization.
domains.errors.invalid: Enter a valid domain. Platform addresses and IP addresses are not allowed.
domains.toast.added: Domain added. Create the DNS records.
platform_domains.title: Organization domains
platform_domains.description: Custom domains organizations added for their branded sites. In manual mode, add each verified host to the site service in Dokploy (port 3000, Let's Encrypt) and mark HTTPS active here.
widget.embed_description: Paste this code where the booking box should appear on your own website.
widget.embed_hint: Your website's address must be in the allowed domains below and the changes must be published. For security, the payment step opens full page.
widget.not_ready_title: The widget is not ready yet
widget.not_ready_description: Turn the site on and save it on the General tab first; the embed code appears here with the site's address.
history.label: Edit history
preview.live_hint: Shows the saved draft and refreshes after every save.
